language.title: Hello, {{name}}! Let’s get acquainted
language.subtitle: Four short steps, and Qadam will suggest teams, competitions and tips for you. Let’s start with the interface language.

study.title: Where do you study?
study.subtitle: This way we can show you competitions and teammates from your faculty.
study.subtitleStaff: Choose your faculty and department so that students can find you.
study.groupEmpty: No group found — you can skip this and add the group later.
study.noStructure: The university has not uploaded its faculties yet. You can skip this step — the data will appear later.

interests.title: What are you interested in?
interests.subtitle: Pick areas and skills — we will suggest projects and teams based on them.

idea.title: Do you already have an idea?
idea.subtitle: It is fine if not: many people start with a team.
idea.legend: Do you have a project idea
idea.yesText: I will describe it in one sentence
idea.noText: I want to join a team or find an idea
idea.hint: Who faces the problem, what it is and what you offer.
idea.placeholder: For example: an app helps farmers in the Turkistan region sell their harvest directly to shops
idea.teamHint: On the “Looking for a team” board students post projects that need people. Have a look after onboarding.
